# Noto Sans KR ExtraBold 800 (2.004-H2)

This directory pins the exact unmodified Google Fonts variable TTF used only
at build time to construct the outlined `주식회사 엘케이로보틱스` corporate
descriptor. Production logo SVGs contain paths and do not load this font.

- Upstream project: https://github.com/notofonts/noto-cjk
- Google Fonts source commit: `4efc2774c63917927efe769ca845def6bd6debae`
- Immutable font source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/4efc2774c63917927efe769ca845def6bd6debae/ofl/notosanskr/NotoSansKR%5Bwght%5D.ttf
- Upstream filename: `NotoSansKR[wght].ttf`
- Vendored filename: `NotoSansKR-wght.ttf`
- Embedded version metadata: `Version 2.004-H2;hotconv 1.0.118;makeotfexe 2.5.65603`
- Font SHA-256: `194018E6B2B293A7964F037B25C0249CE1418BC9AB3C971060A03AA57861E252`
- License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see `OFL.txt`
- OFL SHA-256: `1C05C68C34F9708415AADA51F17E1B0092D2CEA709BF4A94CD38114F9E73D7D9`

The generator pins `fontkit` 2.0.4, selects the named `wght=800`
ExtraBold instance, applies default font positioning plus `0.105em` tracking
between characters only, and exports outlines with uniform scaling and no
manual glyph edits. The corporate descriptor's visible width is `1.90X`,
where `X` is the custom LK symbol's visible height.

Do not modify, subset, convert, or re-export the variable font binary. To
adopt another source commit, version, variation, or construction rule, update
the construction manifest, regenerate every corporate logo asset, perform
visual review, and publish it as an explicit logo revision.
